text.en:
The provisions of Act Numbered Twenty-four hundred and ninety-five, entitled "An Act to
amend certain sections of Act Numbered Twenty-three hundred and forty-seven, entitled 'An Act to provide
for the reorganization of the Courts of First Instance and of the Court of Land Registration,' by changing the
dates of the terms, the seats, and the jurisdiction of certain courts, and for other purposes," are hereby made
applicable to the Department of Mindanao and Sulu.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 26, 1915.
